props.name: start
props.description: Scroll offset, in pixels, where the track starts filling.

props.name: end
props.description: Scroll offset, in pixels, where the track is full. Defaults to the end of the scroller.

props.name: target
props.description: Track reading through this element instead of the whole scroller.

props.name: container
props.description: Scroller to follow. Defaults to the nearest scrolling ancestor, or the window.

props.name: chapters
props.description: One segment per chapter, filled in turn. Straight lines only; ignored with `d`.

props.name: chapterGap
props.description: Space between chapter segments, in pixels.

props.name: onChapterChange
props.description: The chapter being read, as an index into `chapters`.

props.name: progress
props.description: 0–1. A fixed value instead of scroll progress.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction of the default straight line. Ignored when `d` is set.

props.name: d
props.description: Any SVG path, in `viewBox` units, for the fill to follow.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Line width in pixels, or in `viewBox` units for a path.

props.name: rail
props.description: Show the unfilled rest of the line.

props.name: marker
props.description: Node that rides the tip of the fill.

props.name: rotateMarker
props.description: Turn the marker to face along the line.

props.name: pin
props.description: Keep the track stuck to an edge of the scroller.

props.name: smooth
props.description: Seconds the fill takes to catch up with the scroll. `0` follows it exactly.
